observations: Photo 0: Front view of a stainless steel standing gas cooker with four burners (two on top, two on bottom), five white control knobs, and an oven door open to show a wire rack. The top surface shows signs of use and minor discoloration.
Photo 1: Side view showing the top burners and control knobs. The top surface has visible grime and wear, especially on the left burner. The oven door is open, revealing the interior.

Photo 2: Rear view showing the back of the cooker with a control panel and a small label or sticker near the bottom left. The oven door is open, and the interior is visible. The top surface shows signs of use and discoloration.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI HITHE TECHNOLOGIES'.
No brand or model name is visible on any part of the cooker in any photo.
The oven door has a black handle and a black strip across the top, possibly a seal or trim.

claims.claim: Neat refurbished standing Gas Cooker in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear and grime on the top surface, but no proof of functionality. No video or photo of the cooker in operation is provided.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cooker may not be working or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the cooker being turned on, with all burners lighting and the oven heating up.

risks.risk: The oven may not be functional or may have poor heating performance.
risks.proof: A video showing the oven door closing and the interior heating up with a thermometer or timer.

risks.risk: The control knobs or burners may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up video of each knob turning and a burner lighting up.
risks.if_unproven: priced as knobs or burners not working

risks.risk: The cooker may have gas leaks or faulty gas connections not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the gas valve being opened and closed, and a pressure test or leak test.

proof_requests: Video of the cooker being turned on, showing all burners lighting and the oven heating up.
Close-up video of each control knob turning and a burner lighting.
Video showing the oven door closing and interior heating up.
Video showing the gas valve being opened and closed, and a pressure test or leak test.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
